prompt_record.text: Use the attached accepted image as the STYLE anchor: quiet hand-drawn graphite outlines, soft flat ivory fills, faint paper grain, small desaturated rose and muted cyan accents, restrained amber light, raised front three-quarter viewpoint, very light warm-grey background. 4:3 landscape, compact subject slightly above centre and empty calm bottom third for HTML caption. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, buttons, screens or UI. Subject: two separate tool concepts on the tabletop: a plain small card with a single simple unlabelled waveform drawn in graphite on the left; an untextured pale geometric study on the right, a low-poly sphere on a tiny plinth. Give both equal visual weight and clear space between them. No connecting controls, no play button, no shared generation panel, no human or character.
